body: Hi, is the Linen Weekend Dress slightly see-through in daylight?
It has a light airy weave, but we lined the main body so it is not sheer for everyday wear.
Good to know. Does it fit loose at the waist?
Yes, it is cut relaxed through the waist and meant to drape instead of sitting tight.
That sounds close to what I want. I usually sit between a small and medium, so I am trying to figure out which one will give me that loose look without feeling oversized.
If you are between sizes, small will still look relaxed because the shoulder and waist are already cut easy. Medium gives more volume through the skirt and a bit more length.
Would the medium be much longer? I am about 165 cm and I do not want it to hit too low on the calf.
On someone around 165 cm, the small usually lands mid-calf and the medium drops a little lower, closer to lower calf. The difference is noticeable but not dramatic.
That helps. Is the fabric soft from the start or does it need a few washes to relax?
It feels soft right away, but the linen does relax even more after the first couple of washes. It gets a slightly more fluid drape over time.
Does it wrinkle very easily when packed for travel? I am thinking of taking it on a short trip next month.
It will show natural linen creasing if folded in a suitcase, but hanging it overnight usually softens most of the wrinkles. A quick steam makes it crisp again if needed.
Okay. One more thing, are there pockets? I almost always ask because that decides whether I wear a dress often.
Yes, it has side seam pockets on both sides. They sit flat enough that they do not bulk out the shape.
Great, that is a big plus. How should I wash it to keep the shape?
Cold gentle wash, mild detergent, and hang dry is best. If you prefer a cleaner silhouette, steam or warm iron while it is still slightly damp.
Last question, when would it ship if I order this afternoon? I am in Ho Chi Minh City.
If the order comes through today, I can usually dispatch the next business day. Delivery timing depends on the selected service, but I can pack it quickly on my side.
Are the Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones foldable for travel?
Yes, the hinges fold inward and the set packs down easily for a backpack or carry case.
Can they still be used with a cable when the battery is low?
Yes, you can keep listening over a wired connection as well.
Perfect, that covers what I needed.
Does the DualSense controller include a charging cable in this listing?
This listing is for the controller only, so you would need a separate USB-C cable.
Understood. Is it the standard white finish?
Yes, standard white with the usual black accent trim.
